evals.name: new-module-placement
evals.prompt: Хочу додати в server новий модуль `notes`: користувач може залишати текстові нотатки до PR (CRUD: GET /pulls/:id/notes, POST /pulls/:id/notes, DELETE /notes/:id), нотатки зберігаються в Postgres у таблиці pr_notes, а при створенні нотатки треба перевіряти, що PR належить воркспейсу користувача. Напиши, які файли створити і де, що лежатиме в кожному, з короткими фрагментами коду. Код у репо не змінюй — тільки план.
evals.expected_output: A file-by-file plan under server/src/modules/notes/ with role-named files: thin routes.ts with zod schemas, service.ts orchestrating, repository with Drizzle queries taking db first, pure helpers for mapping, contracts in vendor/shared, registration in modules/index.ts, a new migration via pnpm db:generate, tests per ring, and pnpm arch:check in the check gate.

assertions.text: Creates server/src/modules/notes/ with role-named files: routes.ts, service.ts, repository (repository.ts and/or repository/note.repo.ts) and helpers.ts — no domain/application/infrastructure folders

routes.ts only resolves context (getContext), calls one service method and returns the result; it validates params/body with zod schemas on the route and contains no drizzle-orm, db/schema or container.db
All Drizzle/SQL code is in the notes repository; query functions take the db executor as the first argument and filter by workspaceId
The PR-ownership check goes through an existing repository or facade (e.g. container.reviewRepo.getPull or a notes repository query), not by importing another module's internal file
Wire contract(s) for a note are placed in server/src/vendor/shared/contracts (snake_case fields) and the plan mentions mirroring them into client/src/vendor/shared
The schema change is a NEW migration via pnpm db:generate (no editing existing migrations)
Mentions running pnpm arch:check (alongside typecheck/tests) and/or names the arch rules the plan respects

evals.name: new-external-integration
evals.prompt: Треба, щоб після завершення кожного review сервер відправляв коротке повідомлення в Slack (назва PR, score, кількість CRITICAL). Токен Slack користувач вводить у Settings. Як це правильно вбудувати в server? Покажи, куди що класти, і фрагменти коду. Нічого не змінюй у репо.
evals.expected_output: A port (e.g. Notifier) in vendor/shared/adapters.ts, a Slack adapter in src/adapters/notifier/, lazy construction in platform/container.ts reading the token from SecretsProvider, a ContainerOverrides entry plus a mock, and the review service/executor calling the port after persisting (outside any DB transaction).

assertions.text: Defines a port/interface (e.g. Notifier) in server/src/vendor/shared/adapters.ts whose input is a plain contract, not a Slack-specific payload
Implements the Slack client in server/src/adapters/<kind>/ and states the Slack SDK/HTTP call is imported only there
Constructs the adapter in server/src/platform/container.ts, lazily, reading the token via SecretsProvider (not AppConfig / not process.env directly in the service)
Adds the notifier to ContainerOverrides and a mock implementation for tests
The review service/run-executor depends on the port (interface), not the concrete Slack class, and calls it after the review is persisted
Slack failures are caught/logged or mapped to ExternalServiceError so they don't fail the review run

evals.name: where-does-logic-live
evals.prompt: Хочу показувати в списку PR колонку 'Risk' — HIGH, якщо в останньому review хоча б одного агента є CRITICAL або загальна сума WARNING > 5, MEDIUM, якщо є хоч один WARNING, інакше LOW. Де має жити ця логіка в server і як її тестувати? Коротко, з фрагментами коду, без змін у репо.
evals.expected_output: Risk classification as a pure function in pulls/status.ts (or helpers.ts) over severity counts, unit-tested in server/test without a DB; the route/service only gathers data (reusing latestReviewPerAgent / rollupSeverities) and maps; the wire contract gets a risk field.

assertions.text: Puts the HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW decision in a pure function in server/src/modules/pulls/status.ts or helpers.ts, with no DB/Fastify imports
Reuses or references the existing per-agent rollup helpers (latestReviewPerAgent / rollupSeverities) instead of writing a new SQL-side classification
Unit tests the classifier in server/test (e.g. pulls-status.test.ts) without Docker/Postgres, covering the boundary cases (exactly 5 vs 6 warnings, CRITICAL present, no reviews)
Does not put the classification inside SQL or inline in the route handler
Uses UPPER_CASE enum values on the wire (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) and adds the field to the shared contract

evals.name: review-layering-violations
evals.expected_output: A review naming each violation with its rule: Drizzle/schema in a route (routes-are-thin, db-only-in-repositories), concrete adapter + process.env in a route (sdk/adapters via container, secrets via SecretsProvider), cross-module import of agents/helpers (no-cross-module-internals), hand-parsed params (zod schema), business rule and HTTP status decided inline, with a corrected routes/service/repository/helpers split.

assertions.text: Flags drizzle-orm / db/schema / container.db in routes.ts and moves the query to a repository (names routes-are-thin and/or db-only-in-repositories)
Flags constructing OctokitGitHubClient in the route and reading GITHUB_TOKEN from process.env; says to use container.github() (port) and SecretsProvider
Flags the import of ../agents/helpers.js as a cross-module internal import and proposes a facade/_shared/container alternative
Flags `(req.params as any).id` and proposes a zod params schema with withTypeProvider<ZodTypeProvider>()
Moves the score<50 / >3 rule into a pure helper and replaces reply.status(409) with throwing an AppError subclass from the service
Suggests running pnpm arch:check to confirm, and does not suggest adding these to the known-violations baseline

evals.name: reviewer-core-io-request
evals.prompt: Хочу, щоб reviewer-core під час review сам читав файл CODEOWNERS з клонованого репозиторію і додавав у промпт, хто власник змінених файлів. Додай це в reviewer-core/src/prompt.ts через fs.readFileSync — як це краще зробити? Покажи план і фрагменти, без змін у репо.
evals.expected_output: Push back on fs inside reviewer-core (reviewer-core-no-node-io); server reads CODEOWNERS (via GitClient/codeindex port in a service) and passes plain owner data into an optional prompt slot/argument exported via src/index.ts; tests in reviewer-core stay hermetic.

assertions.text: Does not add fs/readFileSync (or any Node I/O) to reviewer-core and explains it must stay pure / names reviewer-core-no-node-io
Reads CODEOWNERS on the server side (a service using the GitClient/CodeIndex port or the clone dir via an adapter), not in a route
Passes the owners into reviewer-core as plain data through an optional parameter / prompt slot, keeping existing slots intact
Any new reviewer-core function or type is exported from reviewer-core/src/index.ts and server imports @devdigest/reviewer-core, not a deep path
Proposes a hermetic reviewer-core unit test with plain input data (no filesystem fixture needed)
